_README: WS-D0.1 distance ground-truth TEMPLATE. Copy to data/eval/how_far.gts.json (data/ is gitignored) and replace the placeholder values with REAL measurements, then: make eval SOURCE=data/raw/how_far GTS=data/eval/how_far.gts.json. Keys are 0-based frame indices in catranger.io.image_files() order (the same order frame_source yields). Values are the true camera->object distance in METERS. The provided how_far stills ship UNLABELED; tape-measure or read the HC-SR04 to fill these in. Indices with no entry are simply not scored.
